Case :- Criminal Misc. Writ Petition No. - 16077 of 2023
Petitioner :- Virendra Singh And 3 Others

Respondent :- State Of U.P. And 3 Others
Counsel for Petitioner :- Sundeep Shukla

Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Syed Imran Ibrahim,Tushar Krishnani Hon'ble Anjani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Vivek Kumar Singh,J.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the first informant and learned A.G.A.
for the State.
The instant writ petition seeks quashing of the FIR dated 05.09.2023 giving rise to Case Crime No.0295 of 2023, under Sections 498A, 324, 307 I.P.C. and Sections- 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act,
1961, Police Station- Wave City, Rural (Commissionerate Ghaziabad), District- Ghaziabad.

Upon hearing learned counsel for the parties and upon perusal of the record, we find that the submissions made on behalf of the petitioners are their defence, which cannot be looked into while Virendra Singh And 3 Others vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/144299408/
1 dealing with a writ petition seeking quashing of a first information report.

sentences.text: Moreover, the allegations made in the First Information Report clearly disclose commission of cognizable offences and the allegations are serious in nature.
Therefore, prayer of the petitioners to quash the First Information Report is completely misconceived and is rejected.
The writ petition is therefore dismissed, without prejudice to the right of the petitioners to apply for bail/anticipatory bail.
